'''Desert Draw''' was a simple card game for two players that was played at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Each player had three cards: a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]], the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]] and a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|Thermal Detonator]]. First each player picked a card out of the three, then the cards were compared. Bounty Hunter beat a Thermal Detonator, Thermal Detonator beat a Sarlacc and Sarlacc beat the Bounty Hunter. It was usually played for money, the winner of a hand received the bets of both players.

The [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Berema]] played Desert Draw with a [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] in the [[Stronghold Cantina|cantina]] of [[Nym's Stronghold]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].

==Behind the scenes==
Desert Draw is a small game offered by the [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] Berema in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It is played via the dialogue options.

The game follows the basic [[Wikipedia:Rock-paper-scissors|rock-paper-scissors principle]].
